Scroll Test Page

This page exists to exercise the browser's rendering pipeline locally instead of depending on external sites: tag stripping, entity decoding, block-level line breaks, list items, and scrolling on a long page.

Copyright © 2026 — some rights reserved. Rock & roll. “Quoted text” and a ‘single-quoted’ word. An ellipsis… and a stray ampersand & should not break anything.
